apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources: [deployment.yaml, admission-policy.yaml]
patches:
  - target:
      group: apps
      version: v1
      kind: Deployment
      name: vuoro-tenant-controller
    patch: |-
      # G2 activation only after G1 receipts. Refuse container reorder, never patch a sidecar.
      - op: test
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/name
        value: controller
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/-
        value:
          name: VUORO_CLOUD_TENANT_DATABASE_ADMIN_URL
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: vuoro-tenant-provisioner-db
              key: VUORO_CLOUD_TENANT_DATABASE_ADMIN_URL
